amendments.change: Add IBM Plex Mono weight 700 to font-mono weight register. Authorized for display-scale brand use (≥18px) only — wordmarks, major headings. Prohibited at data-layer sizes (≤14px).

Remove font-reading (Newsreader). Phase 1 D4 binding: only IBM Plex Mono and Schibsted Grotesk are authorized. Newsreader was never formally approved via the amendment process. Reading-scale content uses Schibsted Grotesk 400 at 16px/lh 1.80.
amendments.prior-value: font-reading: { family: 'Newsreader', usage: 'Long-form reading: briefs, research.' }

meta.notes: v2 — 'The Instrument Line' (supersedes v1 'Masthead & the Mark'). Drop-in remap for existing alfa-ds roles. Registers: 'product' (dark) and 'brand' (light). Inherited hard rules kept: surface-stepped elevation, no shadows, no card borders, pill buttons. v2 hard rules: ONE signal color (Flare, international orange) — the node/step/action only, rationed at ~2% of any surface; brand-text variant for small type contrast; yellow and the v1 accent blue are retired; market up/down are data-only; the step motif appears only where an event actually occurred. v2.1 amendments: P4-01 (IBM Plex Mono 700 at display scale), P4-02 (Newsreader removed — D4 correction).

font-display.usage: Brand/marketing display only — one weight plus italic; emphasis via italic and the line, never bolding.

font-mono.usage: The tape layer: timestamps, tickers, figures, filings (400, 500). Display-scale brand headlines and wordmarks in product dark register (700 only, ≥18px). tabular-nums wherever digits meet.

motion.spec: Material items: underline/line draws left-to-right 550ms then node pops 200ms at the corner — once per event, never looping in product. Numbers tick like tape. Quiet surfaces do not move. Ambient instrument line allowed on brand surfaces only. prefers-reduced-motion renders final states.
